content: Hybrid search in Postgres/Ecto combines a tsvector GIN full-text index and a pgvector HNSW/cosine index on the same table, merged via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF): score = sum(1/(k+rank)) across both ranked result sets, typically k=50, combined via UNION ALL + GROUP BY in one SQL query (or two Ecto queries fused in Elixir). No separate search service needed; agoodway/vecto is a small hex library implementing this pattern for Ecto but rolling it as a raw Ecto fragment/CTE query is straightforward and gives more control.
